records.title: PlanPO: Group Planning-Aware Policy Optimization for Multi-Turn Agentic LLMs
records.reason: Primary abstract proposes group-relative policy optimization for training multi-turn LLM agents; training-only efficiency is outside scope.

records.title: When AI Designs AI: Innovation or Imitation?
records.reason: Primary abstract analyzes algorithmic methods designed by LLM agents; it does not propose inference/serving optimization.

records.title: Completion-Path Credits: Multi-Resource Control for Scale-Up Fabrics
records.reason: Generic interconnect control is evaluated in simulation rather than an LLM-serving stack or end-to-end inference workload; deployment needs calibrated service estimates, so fit is adjacent.

records.title: ArborMem: Navigating Interaction States with Memory Forests
records.reason: Main objective is memory accuracy/continuity; query latency is not full LLM-generation cost, and no inference-cost saving is established across the tested memory workloads.

records.title: Communication Reduction via Semantic-Based Encoding in DMPC Using LSTMs
records.reason: Primary abstract compresses communications for distributed model-predictive control with LSTMs, not language-model inference.
